lines.text: What if humans suddenly stopped needing sleep?
No more tiredness. No more dreams. No more waking up after eight hours.
Imagine having 24 hours every single day.
At first, humanity celebrates.
Factories operate around the clock. Scientists make decades of discoveries in just a few months. Businesses never close, and productivity reaches unimaginable levels.
For the first time, humans have more time than they know what to do with.
But after a few months, something strange begins happening.
People start losing their ability to dream.
Creativity slowly declines. Memories become unreliable. Emotions become unstable.
Despite having more time, people begin feeling increasingly disconnected from reality.
Scientists discover that sleep was never just about resting the body.
It was essential for repairing the brain, processing memories and maintaining mental health.
Without it, the human mind begins to deteriorate.
And then something even stranger happens.
People across the world start experiencing the exact same nightmare while fully awake.
Every person sees the same mysterious black figure standing in the distance.
Scientists investigate the phenomenon and discover an impossible pattern.
The figure appears in every recording, every photograph and every reflection.
But it gets closer every single day.
And then humanity discovers the horrifying truth.
The figure isn't coming closer.
It's been standing in the same place all along.
It's our brains that are slowly forgetting how to recognise reality.
